text.description_html:
Omnia AP-8190/400-US32D, 23-5/8 Inch Modern Square Appliance Handle

This stainless steel appliance pull is great for contemporary kitchens. It has a 1-1/8 inch square grip that is sturdy enough for heavy duty applications. The 23 Inch Modern Square Stainless Steel Appliance Pull can be used on refrigerators and ovens. It has a brushed stainless steel finish. Comes packaged with the necessary mounting hardware.

Also available as a 15-3/4" Modern Square Appliance Handle

Specifications for the Omnia AP-8190/400-US32D Square Appliance Handle:

  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Brushed Stainless Steel
  • Center to Center Mount Holes: 15-3/4"
  • Overall Length: 23-5/8
  • Projection: 3-9/16"
  • Clearance: 2-7/16"
  • Handle Length: 1-1/8" Square
  • Pull Mounting: Standard 3/4" Thick Appliance Panel

Sold Individually
